Powering the Road Ahead

At a press conference on June 12, Aperture Charging Ltd. announced plans to expand the production of its rapid charging stations. With electric cars appearing on driveways and in car parks throughout crowded districts, chief executive Ingrid Sorensen predicts that demand for chargers able to refill a battery in minutes rather than hours will rise sharply over the next few years.

In particular, Ms. Sorensen emphasizes that electric models will eventually account for half of all the cars driven in large cities, taking the place of the petrol vehicles that make those journeys today. “The move away from a tank filled once a week towards a battery topped up wherever the car happens to be parked is unavoidable,” she said. With public grants for low-emission transport rising, the future looks bright for Aperture Charging and for others in the field.
